description: The developer’s server on THEIR Cloudflare account, deployed by Neblla (serverMode "own"; Cloudflare bills them, Neblla only the relay). action "set" { provider: "cloudflare", accountId, apiToken }: checks the token (it needs Workers Scripts: Edit, and the account’s workers.dev subdomain on), keeps it sealed, switches the app to "own" and deploys the box — the same room.js runner as Neblla’s cloud; saving a server/ file redeploys it. "status": the account, the box and its last deploy (never the token). "remove": takes the Worker off their account and forgets the token (the app stays "own": `npx @neblla/server` with the server key still serves it). Ask the developer for the token; never reuse one from elsewhere.

accountId.description: Their Cloudflare account id (32 hex characters)

apiToken.description: A Cloudflare API token with Workers Scripts: Edit on that account

name: neblla_byos
